title: Mediocre 3D
description: This resource pack aims to make most tools/items  render as 3d items with depth and stuff like that, WIP
body:
Mediocre 3D aims to transform simple models into detailed tools without changing the vanilla aspect or vanilla textures. Adding depth and detail through making a custom model for the items/blocks and making the uv lookup specific pixels from the texture, this makes it compatible with any other resource packs.

![Custom Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24c07308112066c1d96c116f5c537a5fa7a900a9.png)

Have you ever felt that your tools were too flat and bland? this texture pack is sure to help you with that problem. This resource pack will surely transform your tools and blocks into the detailed items/blocks that your heart desires.

Custom Item Models!
![Custom Mace Model](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b1d079f2ceb86ac2206417b34293cb70224c580.png)


creator's note: this is my first ever texture pack so forgive me if it has some issues regarding texturing or z-fighting
